images.subject: A large faceted crystal cut in the shape of a five-pointed star, glowing pale blue from within,

images.subject: A small round rocky grey planet seen whole, with a futuristic mining drill rig planted on top of it and a deep glowing pale blue crystal vein cracking across its surface,
